description: JAX reference for the sphere-PEC vector-Nédélec eigenmode pipeline (Epic #88 / Phase G.3 / Issue #128). Per-element curl-curl and ε-mass assembly runs under jax.vmap/jit; global COO scatter and SciPy shift-and-invert eigensolve remain in NumPy (dynamic shapes, no sparse generalized eigensolver in JAX). reference/numpy/sphere_pec.py baseline — physical eigenvalues agree to 1.2e-11 relative, full spectrum to 4.7e-11 absolute at fixture-gen time.
units: dimensionless (k^2, with sphere geometry in arbitrary length units)

mesh_path.description: Path to the bundled Gmsh .msh fixture (reference/fixtures/sphere_pec/sphere.msh).

n_index.description: Refractive index inside the dielectric sphere.

r_buffer.description: Outer vacuum buffer radius (PEC wall location).

n_edges.description: Number of global Nédélec edges (integer cross-check).

n_interior_edges.description: Number of interior Nédélec DOFs after PEC reduction (integer cross-check).

spurious_dim.description: Algebraic spurious-mode dimension = rank(d0_interior) (integer cross-check; Issue #124).

k_int_diag.description: Per-DOF stiffness diagonal, shape [3300]. Catches per-row assembly drift.

m_int_diag.description: Per-DOF mass diagonal, shape [3300]. Catches per-tet epsilon broadcast regression.

eigenvalues_lowest.description: Full lowest-spectrum slice (spurious cluster + physical band), shape [376]. From scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh with shift-and-invert at sigma=0.

eigenvalues_physical.description: Lowest 5 physical eigenvalues (post-spurious filter). Lambda = k^2; expected ~{1.420, 1.420, 1.421, 3.272, 3.277}.

provenance.verified_against: reference/numpy/sphere_pec.py baseline — physical eigenvalues agree to 1.2e-11 relative, full spectrum to 4.7e-11 absolute at fixture-gen time.
